LanguageData.NekoRimWorld_ConnectionHelp: Connect this game to the RimWorld plugin in N.E.K.O. Enter the same port and pairing code in the plugin, then load your colony.
LanguageData.NekoRimWorld_EnableConnectionHelp: Connects to the N.E.K.O plugin on this computer only (127.0.0.1). Generate a pairing code first, then save the same port and code in the plugin settings.
LanguageData.NekoRimWorld_PairingCodeHelp: The button generates a random pairing code. If you enter your own, use {0}–{1} characters.
LanguageData.NekoRimWorld_PairingCodeTooShort: The pairing code is too short. Generate a code before enabling the connection. Closing this window with a short code will leave the connection disabled.
LanguageData.NekoRimWorld_SaveHelp: Close this settings window to save and apply your changes. After generating a new code, update the plugin settings too.
LanguageData.NekoRimWorld_PairingCodePrivacy: The pairing code links your game with N.E.K.O. Keep it private and leave it out of screenshots and shared logs.
